basic_info.description: Welcome to 610 23rd Ave, Hidden Gem in the Coveted Central Richmond! Recently tastefully updated, this lovely home offers an unrivaled tranquil slow-street location & move-in ready condition. Main level features a desirable & rare layout with a refreshed large modern kitchen, formal dining room, spacious living room & 3BD/2BA, including one large master, on the same level. Centrally located, the refreshed kitchen includes all new appliances, a dry bar, pantry closet & breakfast nook. Both master & rear bedroom, facing east into the garden, capture the morning sun & offer spacious manicured garden views. The backyard is a gardener's dream! This low-maintenance backyard with plenty of fruit trees, herbs, & fragrant flower bushes provide an oasis for outdoor gatherings, BBQ, & relaxation. An oversized one car garage offers abundant space for parking, storage, & laundry facility. In this vibrant Richmond location, many dining & shopping options along Clement corridor, Geary & 6th Ave are available. Steps to Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, & Presidio. Public transportation, including the 31 Balboa, 38 Geary & 5 Fulton lines are within walking distance. Top-rated schools are just close by. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to one of the most convenient locations SF has to offer!
